book.name: Maliku
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Maliku gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Ba nya Jiso chiaaŋ yi Balɛt muh wù sage Lum

No bvu gɛ̀ yuude bvu too nɛ, bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bamii ba sage woŋ mo bamii ba duunyi banchi ba Nyo, bɛ bamii bamu bachii ba sage bansa mo bo shii bo chu ntaŋ, bo kaaŋ Jiso, bo jo wu bo gɛɛŋ bo nya chiaaŋ yi Balɛt le.
Balɛt biih Jiso le lɛ, “Le wo wu le Nfoŋ Bajuu?” Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,
Bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ kɛ bo tu bo chuunyi mwɛɛ ye yi Jiso le wesee.
Noo, Balɛt ka wu biih Jiso le lɛ, “Gɛ wo kɛme fiɛɛ fì wo chvuu gɛ? Wo yuge gɛh mwɛɛ mù ba chuunyi yi ye yo le?”
Geenɛ Jiso gɛ chvuu lo fiɛɛ wu le gɛ. Jwe yuŋ Balɛt.
Ge to nyume kife ki Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe wunɛ le, Balɛt bvusɛ muh wu ncha wù mumwaa yeh yi ncha le wù bamii le bo lɛgɛ.
Gɛ̀ bee kife kiyu le, muh mu nyu yeh yi ncha le jee che nyu lɛ Balaba, wu nyu ŋgoo yi bamii ba gɛ̀ bee yeh yi ncha le ba gɛ̀ kɛ ŋgɛ alaantɛŋ bo yuuyɛ bamii.
Kinchvu ki bamii mo ki to ki kɛ ki biide lɛ Balɛt ge gɛh no wu to wù gee fɛ bo le.
Balɛt biih bo le lɛ, “Bɛŋ goone lɛ mbvusɛ nyu Nfoŋ wu Bajuu?”
Wu gɛ̀ biide noo nje wu gɛ̀ kee lɛ bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ le bo nya Jiso chiaaŋ ye le nje bo gɛ̀ bɛɛne kindoŋ bɛ wu.
Geenɛ, bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛɛsɛ kinchvu ki bamii lɛ bo du lɛ wu bvusɛ nyu Balaba.
Balɛt ka wu biih bo le lɛ, “Ndoo mbvusɛ noo, ŋge nɛɛ bɛ muh wunɛ wù bɛŋ tɛŋe lɛ Nfoŋ wu Bajuu?”
Bo mo bo waŋ lo fɛwɛɛwe lɛ, “Ba tâ lo wu yi kintaaŋ le.”
Balɛt biih bo le lɛ, “Ba ta wu nje la? Fiɛɛ fì befe fì wu ge le la?” Bo ka bo wanɛ bo gɛɛne gɛh lo fwe lɛ, “Ba tâ wu yi kintaaŋ le.”
Noo, Balɛt mo wu bvusɛ Balaba nje wu gɛ̀ goone ki wu gê no kinchvu goone. Wu jɛmɛ ba taaŋ Jiso, bo mo bo nya lɛ ba gɛɛŋ ba ta yi kintaaŋ le.
Bamii ba nchi ba Balɛt tu bo chwɛɛse Jiso
Bamii ba nchi baa mo bo jo Jiso bo lee bo gɛɛŋ bɛ wu a nto fɛ ba gɛ̀ tɛŋe lɛ Bletoliuŋ. Lɛ bo lee, bo mo bo kuŋ kimbɛge ki ŋgoo yi bamii ba nchi bachii bo taashɛ.
Bo mo bo jo nju yi bvunfoŋ bo susɛ wu ye le, bo ka bo lu kifo ki bvunfoŋ ki nyu mbiaŋmbiaŋ bo booŋ a wu fwa.
Bo kɛ bo buune wu bo duu lɛ, “Biaa yi bimbaaŋ. Nfoŋ Bajuu.”
No bo gee noo bo tu bo suŋe wu bɛ kimbaŋ yi kikwɛɛ le, bo chuuyi wu bɛ chwɛne ye ye le, bo too bo tumɛ anyuu a wu jii, bo buune wu.
Bo gɛ̀ chwɛɛsɛ wu noo bo mɛsɛ, bo kaasɛ bo baa nju yi bvunfoŋ chiɛɛ, bo jii njú ye, ye ye le, bo mo bo jo wu bo gɛɛne bɛ wu ki bo gɛɛŋ bo ta yi kintaaŋ le.
Ba ta Jiso yi kintaaŋ le
Bo doo bo gɛɛne, bo tasɛ bɛ muh mu wu kwɛɛde nchvuuŋ jee che nyu lɛ Samoŋ, gɛ̀ bee muh wu Sɛliŋ. Wu gɛ̀ bee chiji Alɛksanda bɛ Lufu. Bo mo bo tooŋsɛ wu lɛ wu tuu kintaaŋ ki Jiso.
Bo tu bo gɛɛne bɛ Jiso bo gɛɛŋ bo bu kijusɛ kimu ki ba tɛŋe lɛ Golgota le, (Jee chinɛ le lɛ Ŋgboge wu Kikwɛɛ),
bo mo bo nya mbvuuŋ ma ba fiiŋsɛ bɛ nche yimi ba tɛŋe lɛ mɛɛl. Geenɛ Jiso gɛ mu gɛ.
Bo mo bo ta wu yi kintaaŋ le. Ba jo njú ye ki bo ga bikwɛɛ biboo le, bo tuŋ kaŋ bɛ njú yiyu ki bo kɛɛ muh wu jo.
Kife ki ba gɛ̀ ta Jiso yi kintaaŋ le gɛ̀ bee juu bikaa bvuugɛ ataana.
Bo saŋ ŋwa wu duunyi fiɛɛ fì bo ta wu yi kintaaŋ le nje fi lɛ, wu le, “Nfoŋ wu Bajuu.”
Ba gɛ̀ ta tɛ bachoŋ bafɛɛ yi bintaaŋ le, wumu a kibo ki Jiso kinchiɛɛŋ le, wumu a kibo ke kiŋkoŋo le. [
Fi mo fi kojɛ no ba gɛ̀ saŋ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le lɛ,

content.text: “Ba gɛ̀ ta wu bɛ bamii ba befe.]”

content: Bamii tu bo fede bo yɛde Jiso le bo bɛme bɛ bikwɛɛ, bo baade wu bɛ banchuŋ bo duu lɛ, “Ahaaa! Wo wù chi bee ki wo sâ yeh yi kintanyɛ wo kaasɛ wo jooŋ yi aju le atade,
gɛh fi la kikwɛɛ kuŋ wo shii yi kintaaŋ kɛɛ le.”
Bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bamii ba duunyi banchi ba Nyo tu bo buu tɛ wu lɛbolɛbo bo duu lɛ, “Wu chi fii bamii bamu njɛ wu taŋlo wu fi kikwɛɛ ke sɛŋ.

Wu, wu le Mbvusɛ wu Nyo gɛ̀ ka, wù le Nfoŋ wu bamii ba Ishwala, wu shîi la yi kintaaŋ le mɛɛse bee yɛŋ bee mo be bɛɛŋ wu le.” Bamii baa ba bo gɛ̀ ta yi bintaaŋ le bɛ Jiso tu bo baade tɛ wu bɛ banchuŋ.
Jiso kwe
Juu gɛ̀ bɛɛŋ chi leesɛ, akfuuŋ ja ajiiŋ woŋ wuchii gɛɛne bude juu bikaa bitɛde fɛnshɛ.
Lɛ to nyume juu bikaa bitɛde, Jiso ja wu jaŋ fɛwɛɛwe lɛ,
Fì le lɛ,

content.text: “Nyo waŋ, Nyo waŋ, wo noŋ mɛ nɛ nje la?”

content: Bamii bamu ba gɛ̀ lɛme fo doo bo yu, bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, wu tɛŋe Alaja.”

Muh mu bo le ja wu legɛ wu jo kfusha, wu fuuŋ a mbvuuŋ ma ŋgbwamɛ le, wu booŋ yi finte le wu chiaasɛ lɛ wu mu, bo mo bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Gɛh lɛ̂ɛŋ nɛ besabɛŋ yɛŋ laa Alaja le wu to wu shiishɛ wu yi kintaaŋ kinɛ le lɛ.”
Jiso ja wu waŋ fɛwɛɛwe wu mo wu yɛnɛ n'yɛnɛ wu kimaga.
Nju yì gɛ̀ gade yeh yi kintanyɛ antɛŋ badɛ antɛnɛɛ kɛge fɛwe boge bude fɛkuu bimbe bifɛɛ.
Chiji kikwɛɛ ki bamii ba nchi wù gɛ̀ lɛme a Jiso fwe doo wu yɛŋ je yì Jiso kwe yi le, wu mo wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ, muh wunɛ chi bee Mwa Nyo.”
Bikɛse bamu gɛ̀ lɛme fo je yì ndefe le bo jiiŋe. Ŋgoo yiboo gɛ̀ bee Mɛɛle Madaleŋ bɛ Mɛɛle wù bwe Jɛm wù shige bɛ Yosɛf, wumu nyu Salome.
Bikɛse banɛ le ba gɛ̀ bii Jiso le Galalee bo fii wu. Bo gɛ̀ bee fo bɛ bikɛse bamu tɛ wesee ba gɛ̀ bi Jiso le bɛ bo to Yɛlusalɛm.
Ba jiiyɛ Jiso
Gɛ̀ bee wa fɛnfu abvu, no gɛ̀ bee Juu chi Nseesɛ ki bo lee yi juu chi yuuŋ le,

muh mu wu Alimatia wù ba gɛ̀ tɛŋe lɛ Yosɛf, kaaŋ fitele wu gɛɛŋ wu yɛŋ Balɛt le ki wu lɛ̂gɛ gvunɛ chi Jiso wu gɛɛŋ wu jiiyɛ. Yosɛf wunɛ gɛ̀ bee ŋgoo yi bamii ba sage woŋ, bamii gɛ̀ ŋgvuune wu chuule. Wu kibɛɛ gɛ̀ chiɛɛne tɛ kife kì bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo lé bvu gê bvu tô
Balɛt yu, jwe yuŋ lo wu lɛ Jiso be wu kwe wa. Wu tɛɛŋ kikwɛɛ ki bamii ba nchi kɛɛ ki to, wu biih wu le laa Jiso be wu kwe wa lɛ.
Wu doo wu yu a kikwɛɛ ki bamii ba nchi kiyu le lɛ Jiso be wu kwe wa, wu mo wu nya gvunɛ chiyu Yosɛf le.
Yosɛf mo wu ja wu gɛɛŋ wu gu nju yì joŋe, wu gɛɛŋ wu shiishɛ gvunɛ chi Jiso, wu baŋɛ a nju le, wu gɛɛŋ wu giŋsɛ a jɛŋ yì ba cho yi kimbaaŋ le, wu biŋsɛ kibwee ki tɛdɛ wu baŋɛ jwe wu jɛŋ yɛɛ yu.
Mɛɛle Madaleŋ bɛ Mɛɛle wù bwe Yosɛf yɛŋ kijusɛ ki ba jiiyɛ Jiso fo.

footnotes.text: Mbvuuŋ manɛ gɛ̀ bee ki mo gê lɛ wu kaane shɛ́ŋ lɛ keefɛ wu ka wu yuge nsasɛ gɛ.
Gɛ baŋwa ba kege bamu kɛme kinchiŋ ki 28 gɛ.
